title_original: Fourth edition of the Booksellers’ Photography Book Prize

blocks.text: A booksellers’ prize for photography books, awarded by booksellers France PhotoBook, an association of leading French publishers of photography books, is delighted to announce the fourth edition of the Booksellers’ Prize for Photography Books!

For its fourth edition, the Booksellers’ Prize brings together a jury of fifteen booksellers from across France. Their task is to select a winning book from among 24 titles published during the 2025–2026 academic year by France PhotoBook’s member publishers. The prize, worth €3,000, is awarded to the photographer. The publisher of the winning book also receives support to promote the work, by organising bookshop events. The prize is awarded thanks to the support of the Académie des Beaux-Arts, Pollen Diffusion and the MEP – Maison européenne de la photographie. The jury for this fourth edition is chaired by the writer Maylis de Kerangal. A shortlist of ten titles will be presented in September. A list of five finalists will be announced in early October, ahead of the announcement of the winner on 19 October 2026.
